mentions.name: Canadian Contract Analysis Tool
mentions.description: A tool for analyzing contracts, currently focused on Canada. It aims to help users make sense of frequent contract and EULA updates.
mentions.problem: The inbox gets flooded with contract and EULA updates, making them hard to keep track of and analyze.
mentions.source_excerpt: Getting a lot of contract and eula updates in my inbox so planning on building a tool to analyze contracts. Currently focused on Canada.

evidence.value: Getting a lot of contract and eula updates in my inbox so planning on building a tool to analyze contracts. Currently focused on Canada.
